title: What else needs to be done to Meridian to make it ready for
summary: Meridian extension release-readiness review concluded with 3 tasks approved (capture-race fix, stale-index cleanup, promo tile), 3 sent back (lazy-refresh investigation, privacy policy/disclosures, CI checks), 2 held pending (in-product notice, final validation) — board now 25 Done, 3 Ready, 2 In Review. User requested a run order: (1) lazy-refresh investigation, (2) privacy policy/disclosures, (3) CI checks, then publish PRIVACY.md, approve in-product notice, bump version/build final ZIP, and rerun final Chrome validation last. User then asked to move the in-product privacy disclosure from top of Settings to a bottom expandable section; agent first only updated task requirements (not code), user pushed back that the actual running extension hadn't changed, and agent corrected course — actually editing both source and `meridian-extension/` so Privacy & Data now sits at the bottom of Settings, collapsed by default, expandable via accessible control. All 113 tests pass; user must reload the extension in Chrome and refresh the Meridian tab. User just asked "How did the tasks go?" — awaiting agent's status check on the 3 Ready tasks' execution.
